name: Pickering–Finch Express
description: Weekday peak-direction express service between Pickering GO, western Pickering, Scarborough Centre and Finch, created in the 2013 Highway 2 restructuring and replaced by 92A in 2014.

timeline.event: The new route 98 appears in the June 29 timetable; its weekday-only service first operated Tuesday July 2 after the holiday weekend.
Last operating day of route 98; replacement route 92A began Tuesday September 2.

sources.title: GO Oshawa/Pickering–Finch Express routes 96 and 98, effective June 29, 2013
Major changes to GO bus service along Highway 2, June 29, 2013 — Transit Toronto
GO revises services September 2, 2014, including 98 replacement by 92A — Transit Toronto

gaps: Route 98 is absent from later GTFS snapshots because it ended in 2014; its original timetable is essential evidence.
These are documented dated snapshots. Changes between snapshots, temporary diversions and every historical local stop have not all been recovered.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
